messages.subject: rhandsontable and reactive objects
parts:
Hi,

I have read a few posts and tutorials describing the use of rhandsontable with reactiveValues object and I am wondering if there are any example out there describing the use of reactive objects instead of reactiveValues objects to store the table content.

If reactiveValues must be used, I would be interested to learn how to dynamically initialize a reactiveValues object and set the number and names of slots based upon a character vector of a priori unknown length and content.

Thank you

Sebastien
